adapted_from.source_heading: Direct flash and a fabric flower
adapted_from.source_text: Make a close night portrait of an adult with slick dark hair and a large cobalt fabric flower beside one temple. Use direct on-camera flash so the face is bright and the background falls to black. Keep pores, flyaway hairs and the woven flower edges visible. The flower must attach beside the ear rather than grow from the skin. Use a plain charcoal shirt and a slight forward lean. No beauty retouching, surreal extra eyes or writing.
